requirements.expectation: Creation returns an exact group ID; a three-participant group preserves all participants.
Read-back preserves ID, driver, kind and visibility.
PATCH name/context are independently read back as label/context.
A bounded list contains the exact newly created group, not merely an unrelated nonzero total.
Add/remove changes the exact participant membership and expected cardinality.
An authorized label mutation succeeds and persists; authentication denial is not a pass.
Visibility update succeeds and public visibility is read back.
Actual CLI creation/get preserve exact group/driver identity.
Actual CLI add-member is verified by an independent CLI read.
Actual CLI fusion produces the required recommendation; arbitrary JSON on a nonzero exit does not pass.
Actual CLI completion and termination have independently observed expected states.
Bot-originated three-participant creation returns ID and preserves the label.
ENG mutes itself; returned actor ID and mode match.
Deprecated Workspace PUT and GET return 404; the Group keeps metadata, participant mode, routing, and service settings instead of legacy Workspace state.
Driver structured routes/default delivery and bounded service concurrency persist.
Persistent message ID/routing, live chat and callback group/delivery results match the exact owned scope.
Exact incident group deletion is confirmed and independently returns not-found only after admitted execution convergence.
Proposal preview preserves topic and same-token form action; confirmation creates a queryable group with the proposed driver, followed by exact cleanup.

capability_gaps: Expanded owned-local actors can now be provisioned; versioned Story bindings and legitimate per-operation identities remain required.
Legacy workspace/mode/routing/service/message/callback and full CLI contracts are not migrated.
Current V1 contract has no workspace equivalent; no inferred native or gateway fallback is permitted.
Bootstrap, chat, callback, fusion and proposal effects need admission and terminal/retention handling.
corrections: Do not count a label 401 as PASS.
Do not count nonzero fuse JSON or unverified termination as business success.
Replace global list totals and best-effort group deletion with exact owned identity and durable finalization.

requirements.expectation: Public auto-accept makes the exact intended relationship visible without manual approval.
QA-to-PM is initially absent; exact newly created pending request is accepted by the authorized receiver and friendship is read back.
ENG-to-CS is initially absent; reject the exact new request and verify no friendship was created.
CEO friend list includes the exact ENG relationship established by this Story.
Actual CEO CLI request and PM received-list/accept use distinct legitimate contexts and the exact intended request; acceptance succeeds and PM is present in CEO's final CLI friend list.

capability_gaps: Visibility and relationship mutation are forbidden by the pilot unchanged-friendship contract.
Exact request/relationship ownership, retained history, baseline validation and safe restoration are not implemented.
CLI Bot credentials and remote identity routes need explicit mapping; Human Cookie is not an invented Bot token.
corrections: Existing friendship cannot count as testing request acceptance.
Never select the first pending request or silently skip failed CLI acceptance.
Restore observed original visibility only if it has not drifted, not unconditional public visibility.
Legacy friends do not qualify the separately inventoried edge friend-connections accept/reject/cancel API.

requirements.expectation: Actual PM CLI identity creates a PM-driven group containing PM/ENG and a Session with recoverable exact IDs.
Actual session file upload succeeds and returns file ID after prepare/byte-transfer/complete.
Actual CLI list contains the exact uploaded file.
Actual CLI capabilities returns the declared environment storage backend; local expects local.
Authenticated HTTP metadata returns success and the exact file ID.
Actual CLI download returns exactly the uploaded bytes.
Actual CLI share returns an issued nonempty token.
Token-only HTTP shared metadata succeeds and omits session_id; no ambient user/Bot auth.
Token-only shared HTTP content succeeds and equals the source bytes.
Actual CLI delete succeeds; independently confirm file/share invalidation without replacing failed business deletion with successful fallback cleanup.

capability_gaps: Six actual CLI file leaves and Bot-originated CLI setup are not replaced by PRE-03 HTTP operations.
Legacy capabilities and anonymous metadata are absent from the current V1 file surface; paths must not be guessed.
File complete can notify Bots and create a separate completion link; effect admission remains mandatory.
CLI upload failures may hide a created file ID; unknown outcomes cannot authorize blind retries or broad cleanup.
corrections: Missing CLI token or skipped operation is not PASS.
Retain unknown prepare/upload outcomes; register exact file and both explicit/initial Session parents.
Clean file/upload before Sessions/group, preserve failures, and isolate temporary CLI/local-file credentials.
